notes.title: Demo Updated & Kickstarter Live!
notes.content:
Hey there!

First of all, huge thanks for all the feedback you sent in since our demo went live! Hearing what everyone likes and dislikes has been tremendously helpful in determining the best path forward for Fading Skies. A lot of this has already taken shape in previous updates, and more improvements have been added today: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894081/fc355ebd256467499a7e9076c7c6eb3c92bfd0e0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Upgrades for combat dashes!
[*]New ability for retrieving lost aether!
[*]Sprinting (even before the end of the demo 😉)!
[*]Improved flight tutorial!
[*]Improved level design!
[*]Mysterious lotus flower gate?
[*]Various bug fixes!
[*]Full patch notes on [url=https://discord.com/invite/jk7HbYs2Cf]our Discord[/url]!
[/list]
If you enjoyed your time with Fading Skies so far and want to support us in creating the rest of Ryn and Kyo’s adventure, please check out our Kickstarter. We’re currently 125% funded with 21 days to go, and just reached our first stretch goal: The ability to pet your dragon any time you want! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894081/059658b2992574871aebf54d180c8f5fe1e83cbb.gif[/img]

If you think no additional stretch goal could be more important than that... Well, you wouldn't be entirely wrong. But consider these: 
[list]
[*] A new optional outfit for Ryn! 
[*] Pet the Neykos and cat and other cute creatures! 
[*] MORE MUSIC WITH EMI EVANS!! 
[/list]We hope you'll agree that all of these would be amazing additions to improve Fading Skies even further. If you want to help us reach these milestones and get exclusive rewards along the way, check out the link below:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/distantbluegames/fading-skies]Support Fading Skies on Kickstarter[/url]

We truly appreciate the support you’ve shown this project so far, and will channel every ounce of it into making the full release of Fading Skies an unforgettable adventure!

- Ronja & Marc

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894081/116859a5b86d273cd9eb6495be067b2fe734f690.png[/img]
